items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: So then Mittlek spoke up and said, "What do you expect the man to do?

ctx.x: And he just come down on him that day. And I said, "Well, I don't think it was him. I think it was me and I wouldn't want to see him get fired unless it was really, you know, for something he didn't do."

So then Mittlek spoke up and said, "What do you expect the man to do? Do you expect him to keep him after he cut him on his hand and all that, you know?" So that was Mittlek, so then I backed out of it, because I'm not about to talk to Mittlek.
